title: Routine Management & Session Adaptation
observations: TDD red phase prevented silent bugs; 62 tests in 3 packages all pass on first green run
Synchronous execution model of provisionSession not explicit in architecture plan; caused 2/3 of fix cycles (temporal ordering bug)
Back-population timing bug required 3 fix rounds: R1 missing integration, R2 wrong timing assumption, R3 correct fix (routineId+outcome, not sessionId)
Two-review model (critique + code review) necessary for integration-heavy features; each lens caught different gaps
Red phase mocked provisioning; didn't test full end-to-end hook. Integration tests should exercise entire data flow
Coalescing constraint enabled Option C correctness; test-first discipline proved the invariant holds
All 6 ACs delivered PASS; 37% rework cost acceptable for temporal-ordering bug discovery
cost_signals: Rework cost high (37%) due to temporal-ordering bug on critical path
Better plan clarity on execution models + end-to-end integration tests would reduce rework to <20%
compound_candidates: CC-010: TDD red phase prevents silent bugs (confirmed X3, W2, AB3)
CC-009: Critique effectiveness for architecture gaps (confirmed X2, AB3)
CC-001: Process discipline: code review gates before ship (pattern recurs)
CC-003: Specification clarity and execution models (synchronous execution model gotcha)
